description: Phase 1 character DNA for the twelve cinematic chess warriors. Geometry comes from the sculpted-hybrid forge; identity remains data-driven.

identityRules.faceApproval: No Tumbo face-bearing asset, screenshot, GLB, texture, or demo build is published without Tumbo's explicit approval.
identityRules.malePieces: King, Bishop, Knight warrior torso, Rook, and Pawn use FACE_Tumbo_Male_01 only through the local/private MetaHuman review pipeline until approved.
identityRules.queens: Queens use FACE_Feminine_Regal_01 and never use Tumbo's face texture.
identityRules.materials: Black = obsidian + gold filigree; White = ivory + gold. Gold trim is mandatory on every role.
